Dear Ms. Ramirez,

Re: Account reference: ACC-309902

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the above-referenced account. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt and have asked us to cease collection efforts until this request is fulfilled.

We confirm that the original creditor for this account is Heartland Savings Bank and that the current balance is $3,197.24. We also confirm that the account was charged off on June 28, 2020. We have no record of any payments being made on this account.

In accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to provide you with validation of the debt. We will investigate your request and provide you with the necessary documentation to support the debt.

Please be advised that we will cease collection efforts on this account until we have provided you with the requested validation. We will also investigate your claim that we have reported this account to a credit bureau and will take corrective action if necessary.

You have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe that the information we provide is inaccurate or incomplete. Please note that we are required to provide you with a written validation notice within 30 days of your request.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
